_about: Reasons to come back (GameSession+Rewards.swift). `dailyGifts`: one a calendar day, the next in the round each day you play (missing a day costs nothing), gold as `goldPerLevel` × your level. `bounties`: `perDay` tasks a day, each kind's count rolled in [low, high] (defeatOnMap: monsters on a land you've been to that suits your level; defeatElement: monsters of an element found there; wins: fights won; rare: rare monsters; seal: monsters sealed), each paying `exp` × the EXP your level needs and `goldPerLevel` × your level, and the `bonus` once all are claimed. `quests`: the least a quest pays when you hand it in, for your level then: `exp` × the EXP your level needs and `goldPerLevel` × your level, a bit more than a bounty (its own gold and EXP when they're higher; a quest that pays no gold or no EXP still pays none). `bookMilestones`: paid once each when the Monster Book reaches `count` kinds of monster (no count: every one). `cards`: monster cards (Fairyland Online's card collection; GameSession+Collection.swift). A beaten monster leaves its card one time in `chance` (`rareChance` for a rare one, `bossChance` for a boss). The first of each goes in the Monster Book and raises the hero's stat for its element (`gains`: `stat`, and `perStep`) for good: a step, and another for every `levelsPerStep` levels of where the monster lives (the middle of the gentlest band it turns up in, or a boss's level), times `rare` or `boss` for theirs. A spare is sold on the spot for `spareGold` times the gold the monster pays at that level. `seals`: a hard win leaves a Seal Stone: the highest of `tiers` whose `above` the strongest beaten monster's level is over yours (as it was before the fight), one time in `chance`, one of its `items` (repeats weigh more); a boss fight uses `boss`. 5 above you is when the tougher battle theme plays. `chests`: a treasure chest you've opened (its own treasure the first time) fills again `refillHours` after, with gold as `goldPerLevel` × its level (its own treasure's) and one thing: a piece of gear around that level `gearChance` of the time, else one of `items` (repeats weigh more).
